summary: Tested 4 SC Direct Flow changes: (1) Sales Order search box - WORKING, (2) SC checkbox creates SC Order directly with first-level BOM components - WORKING, (3) No child MOs when SC - WORKING, (4) Consolidation of SC orders for same supplier+SO - WORKING. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: search input, SC checkbox, SC type radio buttons, supplier dropdown all present and functional.
passed_tests: Sales Order page has search input (data-testid='so-search-input') that filters by order number, product name, BOM name
POST /api/work-orders with is_subcontract=true returns is_sc_direct=true and sc_order object
POST /api/work-orders with is_subcontract=true returns empty work_orders array (no MOs created)
SC Order has production_order_id, fg_item_id, fg_quantity fields
SC Order lines contain first-level BOM components (not FG item when BOM exists)
With Material type: sent_quantity > 0 in SC lines
Without Material type: sent_quantity = 0 in SC lines
Consolidation: 2nd SC for same supplier + same SO merges into existing SC order
Normal MO creation still works when is_subcontract=false (returns work_orders array)
Frontend: Create MO dialog has SC checkbox (data-testid='wo-subcontract-check')
Frontend: SC Type radio buttons (With Material / Without Material) appear when SC checked
Frontend: Supplier dropdown appears when SC checked
Frontend: Alert shows SC order number when is_sc_direct=true (code verified)
seed_data_creation: Created SC orders during testing via POST /api/work-orders with is_subcontract=true
context_for_next_testing_agent: SC Direct Flow features verified working. Key findings: (1) Sales Order page has search input that filters by order_number, item.part_number, item.name, bom.name - WORKING, (2) When is_subcontract=true in POST /api/work-orders, response has is_sc_direct=true, sc_order object, and empty work_orders array - WORKING, (3) SC Order lines contain first-level BOM components (not FG item) - WORKING, (4) Consolidation merges SC orders for same supplier + same SO - WORKING, (5) With Material has sent_quantity > 0, Without Material has sent_quantity = 0 - WORKING, (6) Frontend handles is_sc_direct response and shows alert with SC order number - WORKING. Test data: Multiple SC orders created during testing. Existing MOs visible: MO-000019, MO-000018, MO-000017 (completed, SC), MO-000016 (in_progress, SC), MO-000015 (completed, SC), MO-000014 (in_progress, SC).
